items.text: Retain localhost enrollment, Host/Origin/page-token/realpath guards and no outbound network behavior from SECURITY.md.
Capture review artifacts and explicit comments only; no agent session, transcript, token or credential capture.
Preserve canonical workflow authority, source drift guards, approved artifacts, closed packs and historical formats.
Use the authoritative harness and canonical installer for requested Claude/Codex/Pi surface updates.
Bound snapshot bytes, round count, comment size, store size and wait duration; never silently truncate review targets.

items.decision: Keep feedback/1 state and immutable round files under the active pack feedback/ directory, separate from the canonical specpack; use the existing pack writer lock and durable atomic publication.
items.because: A separate file format avoids changing approved plan digests or legacy corpus bytes. SQLite adds a dependency and migration surface; putting comments in canonical JSON couples conversation to owner receipts.

items.decision: Use a portable CLI open/wait/read/reply/round bridge plus an installed feedback skill; bounded cursor reads deliver submitted batches, with explicit next-prompt/manual fallback for idle hosts.
items.because: All named hosts can run commands and read files in the reference pattern. Native RPC/SDK session control has host-specific authority, lifecycle and trust costs outside the selected scope. Real-host witnesses remain mandatory.

items.decision: Snapshot explicit Markdown targets and selected Git diff paths with exact content hashes, baseline commit IDs and before/after line anchors; source changes make anchors stale rather than silently moving them.
items.because: Live line numbers and a whole-worktree diff can misaddress edits or capture unrelated changes. Explicit immutable snapshots give an auditable referent; heuristic auto-reattachment is deferred.

items.decision: Keep feedback submit, agent replies and owner resolution separate from the existing spec/decision/Start/PACK/Finish workflow. Expose pending feedback without creating a hidden execution permission or automatic approval.
items.because: Crit-style feedback completion is insufficient for Wukong owner authority. Reusing core gates preserves frozen artifacts and makes scope drift require owner review; unresolved feedback remains visible rather than silently clearing.

items.decision: Add a Feedback view to the shared project-qualified Wukong library, with source line/diff anchors and existing sandboxed Markdown preview; keep legacy foreground views disabled for this feature.
items.because: The shared application already provides enrolled-project routing and page-token guards. Crit embedding introduces a second service and protocol; exposing new writes in the legacy foreground server would require another security surface.

items.title: Feedback state and immutable rounds
items.detail: Versioned nested store, revisions, operation IDs, immutable snapshots, draft/batch/reply/thread state and frozen history. Reattachment drafts are explicitly submitted on the new round; sealed rounds never require inaccessible owner action.

items.text: Feedback MUST preserve specpack 0.2/0.3/0.4 bytes and core discovery; active 0.4 enables writes, legacy and completed records get clear unsupported/read-only behavior.
